      function findDropTarget(cx, cy, excludeUid = null) {
        let best = null;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        for (const item of boardItems) {
          if (item.uid === excludeUid) continue;
          const r = item.el.getBoundingClientRect();
          const ix = r.left + r.width / 2;
          const iy = r.top + r.height / 2;
          const pad = 18;
          const inside = cx >= r.left - pad && cx <= r.right + pad && cy >= r.top - pad && cy <= r.bottom + pad;
          if (!inside) continue;
          const dist = Math.hypot(cx - ix, cy - iy);
          if (dist < bestDist) {
            bestDist = dist;
            best = item;
          }
        }
        return best;
      }

      /* =====================================================================
       * 7. LÓGICA DE COMBINACIÓN
       * ===================================================================== */
      function resolveCombination(idA, idB) {
        const key = recipeKey(idA, idB);
        if (RECIPE_MAP.has(key)) {
          return { id: RECIPE_MAP.get(key), source: "curated" };
        }
        // Solo usar fallback temático si ambos son elementos curados
        if (ELEMENTS[idA] && ELEMENTS[idB]) {
          const fb = smartCuratedFallback(idA, idB);
          if (fb && fb !== idA && fb !== idB) {
            return { id: fb, source: "fallback" };
          }
        }
        if (state.freeMode) {
          return { id: generateFreeCombo(idA, idB), source: "free" };
        }
        return null;
      }

      function combineItems(idA, idB, targetItem, sourceItem = null) {
        const elA = getElement(idA);
        const elB = getElement(idB);
        const result = resolveCombination(idA, idB);

        const wsRect = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tRect = targetItem.el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = tRect.left - wsRect.left + tRect.width / 2;
        const cy = tRect.top - wsRect.top + tRect.height / 2;

        if (!result) {
          SFX.nope();
          targetItem.el.classList.add("anim-shake");
          targetItem.el.addEventListener("animationend", () => targetItem.el.classList.remove("anim-shake"), { once: true });
          if (sourceItem) {
            // Separar ligeramente para que no se solapen
            const nx = Math.max(12, Math.min(wsRect.width - sourceItem.el.offsetWidth - 12, targetItem.x + 56));
            const ny = Math.max(70, Math.min(wsRect.height - sourceItem.el.offsetHeight - 68, targetItem.y + 34));
            sourceItem.x = nx;
            sourceItem.y = ny;
            sourceItem.el.style.transform = `translate(${nx}px, ${ny}px)`;
          }
          const quip = NO_MATCH_QUIPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * NO_MATCH_QUIPS.length)];
          showToast({
            tag: "Sin reacción",
            tagClass: "nope",
            formula: `${elA.emoji} ${elA.name} + ${elB.emoji} ${elB.name}`,
            desc: quip
          }, 2800);
          return;
        }

        const resId = result.id;
        const resEl = getElement(resId);
        const isNew = !state.discovered.includes(resId);

        state.combines++;
        if (isNew) {
          state.discovered.push(resId);
          if (!state.discoveredRecipes[resId]) {
            state.discoveredRecipes[resId] = [idA, idB];
          }
        } else if (!state.discoveredRecipes[resId]) {
          state.discoveredRecipes[resId] = [idA, idB];
        }
        saveState();

        // Retirar piezas originales y crear la nueva
        removeBoardItem(targetItem.uid);
        if (sourceItem) removeBoardItem(sourceItem.uid);

        spawnBoardItem(resId, cx, cy, { isNew });

        // Efectos y feedback
        if (isNew) {
          if (resEl.rarity === "legendary") {
            SFX.legendary();
            spawnBurst(cx, cy, "legendary");
          } else if (resEl.isFree) {
            SFX.discover();
            spawnBurst(cx, cy, "free");
          } else {
            SFX.discover();
            spawnBurst(cx, cy, "new");
          }

          showToast({
            tag: resEl.rarity === "legendary" ? "★ Legendario" : resEl.isFree ? "∞ Fusión Libre" : "✨ Nuevo descubrimiento",
            tagClass: resEl.rarity === "legendary" ? "legendary" : resEl.isFree ? "free" : "",
            formula: `${elA.emoji} ${elA.name} + ${elB.emoji} ${elB.name}`,
            title: `${resEl.emoji} ${resEl.name}`,
            desc: resEl.desc,
            variant: resEl.rarity === "legendary" ? "is-legendary" : "is-new"
          }, 5600);
        } else {
          SFX.combineKnown();
          spawnBurst(cx, cy, "normal");
          showToast({
            tag: "Sintetizado",
            tagClass: resEl.isFree ? "free" : "nope",
            formula: `${elA.emoji} ${elA.name} + ${elB.emoji} ${elB.name}`,
            title: `${resEl.emoji} ${resEl.name}`,
            desc: resEl.desc
          }, 3200);
        }

        renderProgress();
        renderInventory();
      }

      /* =====================================================================
       * 8. ARRASTRE CON POINTER EVENTS (TABLERO Y SIDEBAR)
       * ===================================================================== */
      let activeHighlight = null;

      function setHighlight(target) {
        if (activeHighlight === target) return;
        if (activeHighlight) activeHighlight.el.classList.remove("drop-target");
        activeHighlight = target;
        if (activeHighlight) activeHighlight.el.classList.add("drop-target");
      }

      function isOverSidebar(clientX, clientY) {
        const r = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect();
        return clientX >= r.left && clientX <= r.right && clientY >= r.top && clientY <= r.bottom;
      }

      function onBoardPointerDown(e, item) {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        SFX.pickup();
        item.el.style.zIndex = ++topZ;
        item.el.classList.add("dragging");

        const wsRect = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startY = e.clientY;
        const origX = item.x;
        const origY = item.y;

        const onMove = (ev) => {
          const dx = ev.clientX - startX;
          const dy = ev.clientY - startY;
          item.x = origX + dx;
          item.y = origY + dy;
          item.el.style.transform = `translate(${item.x}px, ${item.y}px) rotate(-1.5deg)`;

          const overTrash = isOverSidebar(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
          sidebar.classList.toggle("trash-hover", overTrash);

          if (overTrash) {
            setHighlight(null);
          } else {
            const target = findDropTarget(ev.clientX, ev.clientY, item.uid);
            setHighlight(target);
          }
        };

        const onUp = (ev) => {
          window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
          window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
          window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);

          item.el.classList.remove("dragging");
          sidebar.classList.remove("trash-hover");
          const target = activeHighlight;
          setHighlight(null);

          if (isOverSidebar(ev.clientX, ev.clientY)) {
            SFX.trash();
            removeBoardItem(item.uid);
            return;
          }

          if (target) {
            combineItems(item.id, target.id, target, item);
            return;
          }

          // Mantener dentro del lienzo
          const w = item.el.offsetWidth;
          const h = item.el.offsetHeight;
          item.x = Math.max(8, Math.min(wsRect.width - w - 8, item.x));
          item.y = Math.max(60, Math.min(wsRect.height - h - 56, item.y));
          item.el.style.transform = `translate(${item.x}px, ${item.y}px)`;
        };

        window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
        window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
      }

      function onSidebarChipPointerDown(e, id) {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        const data = getElement(id);
        if (!data) return;

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startY = e.clientY;
        let dragging = false;
        let ghost = null;

        const onMove = (ev) => {
          const dist = Math.hypot(ev.clientX - startX, ev.clientY - startY);
          if (!dragging && dist > 6) {
            dragging = true;
            SFX.pickup();
            ghost = document.createElement("div");
            ghost.className = "drag-ghost";
            ghost.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:18px">${data.emoji}</span><span>${data.name}</span>`;
            document.body.appendChild(ghost);
          }
          if (!dragging) return;

          const gw = ghost.offsetWidth;
          const gh = ghost.offsetHeight;
          ghost.style.transform = `translate(${ev.clientX - gw / 2}px, ${ev.clientY - gh / 2}px) rotate(-1.5deg)`;

          if (!isOverSidebar(ev.clientX, ev.clientY)) {
            setHighlight(findDropTarget(ev.clientX, ev.clientY));
          } else {
            setHighlight(null);
          }
        };

        const onUp = (ev) => {
          window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
          window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
          window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);

          const target = activeHighlight;
          setHighlight(null);

          if (ghost) ghost.remove();

          if (!dragging) {
            // Clic simple -> aparece en el centro del tablero con ligero desplazamiento aleatorio
            SFX.spawn();
            const r = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
            const jx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.min(200, r.width * 0.38);
            const jy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.min(160, r.height * 0.34);
            spawnBoardItem(id, r.width / 2 + jx, r.height / 2 + jy);
            return;
          }

          if (isOverSidebar(ev.clientX, ev.clientY)) return;

          if (target) {
            combineItems(id, target.id, target, null);
          } else {
            SFX.spawn();
            const wsRect = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
            spawnBoardItem(id, ev.clientX - wsRect.left, ev.clientY - wsRect.top);
          }
        };

        window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
        window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
      }

      /* =====================================================================
       * 9. SISTEMA DE PISTAS INTELIGENTE
       * ===================================================================== */
      function showSmartHint() {
        const unlocked = new Set(state.discovered);
        const candidates = [];

        for (const [key, resId] of RECIPE_MAP.entries()) {
          if (unlocked.has(resId)) continue;
          const [a, b] = key.split("+");
          if (unlocked.has(a) && unlocked.has(b)) {
            candidates.push({ a, b, resId, key });
          }
        }

        if (candidates.length === 0) {
          showToast({
            tag: "🏆 ¡Completado!",
            tagClass: "legendary",
            title: "¡Has descubierto todos los elementos curados de Web Reactiva!",
            desc: "Puedes activar ∞ Modo Libre para crear fusiones experimentales infinitas."
          }, 5500);
          return;
        }

        // Priorizar pistas no legendarias primero o elegir una estable si repite clic
        let pick = candidates.find((c) => c.key === lastHintKey);
        if (pick && hintStage === 1) {
          hintStage = 2;
          const elA = getElement(pick.a);
          const elB = getElement(pick.b);
          const elR = getElement(pick.resId);
          SFX.spawn();
          showToast({
            tag: "💡 Pista exacta",
            tagClass: "hint",
            title: `Prueba: ${elA.emoji} ${elA.name} + ${elB.emoji} ${elB.name}`,
            desc: `Desbloquea un elemento de la categoría "${getCategoryLabel(elR.cat)}".`
          }, 5500);
          lastHintKey = null;
          hintStage = 0;
          return;
        }

        // Elegir una nueva pista aleatoria
        pick = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
        lastHintKey = pick.key;
        hintStage = 1;
        const elA = getElement(pick.a);
        const elR = getElement(pick.resId);
        SFX.spawn();
        showToast({
          tag: "💡 Pista (1/2)",
          tagClass: "hint",
          title: `Usa ${elA.emoji} ${elA.name} + ???`,
          desc: `Te llevará a algo de "${getCategoryLabel(elR.cat)}". Pulsa 💡 Pista otra vez si quieres la pareja exacta.`
        }, 5200);
      }

      function getCategoryLabel(catId) {
        if (catId === "free") return "Fusiones Libres";
        const found = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === catId);
        return found ? found.label : catId;
      }

      /* =====================================================================
       * 10. RENDER DE SIDEBAR, PROGRESO Y ATLAS MALANDRINER
       * ===================================================================== */
      function renderProgress() {
        const curatedFound = state.discovered.filter((id) => Boolean(ELEMENTS[id])).length;
        const total = CURATED_IDS.length;
        const pct = Math.round((curatedFound / total) * 100);
        progressText.textContent = `${curatedFound} / ${total}`;
        progressPct.textContent = `${pct}%`;
        progressFill.style.width = `${Math.max(2, pct)}%`;
        combinesCounter.textContent = `${state.combines} ${state.combines === 1 ? "mezcla" : "mezclas"}`;
      }

      function renderCategoryPills(container, activeId, onSelect, includeFree = true) {
        const hasFree = state.discovered.some((id) => !ELEMENTS[id]);
        const list = [...CATEGORIES];
        if (includeFree && hasFree) {
          list.push({ id: "free", label: "∞ Libres" });
        }

        container.innerHTML = "";
        for (const cat of list) {
          const btn = document.createElement("button");
          btn.className = "cat-pill" + (cat.id === activeId ? " active" : "");
          btn.textContent = cat.label;
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => onSelect(cat.id));
          container.appendChild(btn);
        }
      }

      const RARITY_WEIGHT = { legendary: 4, epic: 3, rare: 2, common: 1, free: 0 };

      function renderInventory() {
        renderCategoryPills(catPillsEl, state.activeCat, (catId) => {
          state.activeCat = catId;
          saveState();
          renderInventory();
        });

        const q = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        let ids = [...state.discovered];

        if (state.activeCat !== "all") {
          ids = ids.filter((id) => {
            const el = getElement(id);
            return el && el.cat === state.activeCat;
          });
        }

        if (q) {
          ids = ids.filter((id) => {
            const el = getElement(id);
            return el && (el.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || el.desc.toLowerCase().includes(q));
          });
        }

        if (state.sortMode === "recent") {
          ids.reverse();
        } else if (state.sortMode === "alpha") {
          ids.sort((a, b) => getElement(a).name.localeCompare(getElement(b).name, "es"));
        } else if (state.sortMode === "rarity") {
          ids.sort((a, b) => (RARITY_WEIGHT[getElement(b).rarity] || 0) - (RARITY_WEIGHT[getElement(a).rarity] || 0));
        }

        inventoryList.innerHTML = "";
        if (ids.length === 0) {
          inventoryList.innerHTML = `<div class="inv-empty">No hay elementos que coincidan con ese filtro.</div>`;
          return;
        }

        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const id of ids) {
          const el = getElement(id);
          const chip = document.createElement("div");
          chip.className = "inv-chip";
          if (el.rarity === "legendary") chip.classList.add("rarity-legendary");
          else if (el.rarity === "epic") chip.classList.add("rarity-epic");
          else if (el.rarity === "rare") chip.classList.add("rarity-rare");
          if (el.isFree) chip.classList.add("is-free");

          chip.title = el.desc;
          const dot = (el.rarity === "legendary" || el.rarity === "epic" || el.rarity === "rare")
            ? `<span class="rarity-dot"></span>`
            : "";
          chip.innerHTML = `<span>${el.emoji}</span><span>${el.name}</span>${dot}`;
          chip.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => onSidebarChipPointerDown(e, id));
          frag.appendChild(chip);
        }
        inventoryList.appendChild(frag);
      }

      function renderAtlas() {
        const unlocked = new Set(state.discovered);
        const curatedFound = state.discovered.filter((id) => Boolean(ELEMENTS[id]));
        const legendaryFound = curatedFound.filter((id) => ELEMENTS[id].rarity === "legendary").length;
        const legendaryTotal = CURATED_IDS.filter((id) => ELEMENTS[id].rarity === "legendary").length;
        const freeFound = state.discovered.filter((id) => !ELEMENTS[id]).length;

        document.getElementById("stat-found").textContent = `${curatedFound.length}/${CURATED_IDS.length}`;
        document.getElementById("stat-legendary").textContent = `${legendaryFound}/${legendaryTotal}`;
        document.getElementById("stat-free").textContent = `${freeFound}`;
        document.getElementById("stat-combines").textContent = `${state.combines}`;

        renderCategoryPills(atlasCatPills, atlasCat, (c) => {
          atlasCat = c;
          renderAtlas();
        }, true);

        let listIds;
        if (atlasCat === "free") {
          listIds = state.discovered.filter((id) => !ELEMENTS[id]);
        } else {
          listIds = CURATED_IDS.filter((id) => atlasCat === "all" || ELEMENTS[id].cat === atlasCat);
          // Descubiertos primero, luego por rareza
          listIds.sort((a, b) => {
            const ua = unlocked.has(a) ? 1 : 0;
            const ub = unlocked.has(b) ? 1 : 0;
            if (ua !== ub) return ub - ua;
            return (RARITY_WEIGHT[ELEMENTS[b].rarity] || 0) - (RARITY_WEIGHT[ELEMENTS[a].rarity] || 0);
          });
        }

        atlasGrid.innerHTML = "";
        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const id of listIds) {
          const el = getElement(id);
          const isUnlocked = unlocked.has(id);
          const card = document.createElement("div");
          card.className = "atlas-card " + (isUnlocked ? "unlocked" : "locked");
          if (el.rarity === "legendary") card.classList.add("rarity-legendary");

          if (isUnlocked) {
            const rec = state.discoveredRecipes[id];
            let recHtml = el.starter ? "Elemento inicial" : "";
            if (rec && getElement(rec[0]) && getElement(rec[1])) {
              const ra = getElement(rec[0]);
              const rb = getElement(rec[1]);
              recHtml = `${ra.emoji} ${ra.name} + ${rb.emoji} ${rb.name}`;
            }

            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="atlas-card-top">
                <div class="atlas-card-name"><span>${el.emoji}</span><span>${el.name}</span></div>
                <span class="atlas-card-cat">${el.rarity === "legendary" ? "★ Legendario" : getCategoryLabel(el.cat)}</span>
              </div>
              <p class="atlas-card-desc">${el.desc}</p>
              ${recHtml ? `<div class="atlas-card-recipe">${recHtml}</div>` : ""}
            `;
            card.addEventListener("click", () => {
              closeAtlas();
              SFX.spawn();
              const r = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
              spawnBoardItem(id, r.width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 140, r.height / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120);
            });
          } else {
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="atlas-card-top">
                <div class="atlas-card-name"><span>🔒</span><span>???</span></div>
                <span class="atlas-card-cat">${el.rarity === "legendary" ? "★ Legendario" : getCategoryLabel(el.cat)}</span>
              </div>
              <p class="atlas-card-desc">Aún por descubrir. Experimenta combinando elementos en el tablero.</p>
            `;
          }
          frag.appendChild(card);
        }
        atlasGrid.appendChild(frag);
      }

      function openAtlas() {
        renderAtlas();
        atlasModal.classList.add("open");
        atlasModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      }

      function closeAtlas() {
        atlasModal.classList.remove("open");
        atlasModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      }

      /* =====================================================================
       * 11. TEMA, CONTROLES Y EVENTOS GLOBALES
       * ===================================================================== */
      function applyTheme() {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", state.theme);
        btnTheme.textContent = state.theme === "dark" ? "☀️" : "🌙";
      }

      function applyButtonsState() {
        btnSound.textContent = state.sound ? "🔊" : "🔇";
        btnFree.classList.toggle("active", state.freeMode);
        const sortLabels = { recent: "Recientes", alpha: "A–Z", rarity: "Rareza" };
        btnSort.textContent = sortLabels[state.sortMode] || "Recientes";
      }

      btnTheme.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.theme = state.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
        saveState();
        applyTheme();
      });

      btnSound.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.sound = !state.sound;
        saveState();
        applyButtonsState();
        if (state.sound) SFX.spawn();
      });

      btnFree.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.freeMode = !state.freeMode;
        saveState();
        applyButtonsState();
        SFX.spawn();
        showToast({
          tag: state.freeMode ? "∞ Modo Libre ON" : "Modo Curado",
          tagClass: state.freeMode ? "free" : "hint",
          title: state.freeMode ? "Alquimia sin límites activada" : "Solo descubrimientos curados de Web Reactiva",
          desc: state.freeMode
            ? "Cualquier pareja sin receta oficial creará una fusión experimental nueva."
            : "Las fusiones no registradas rebotarán para mantener tu Atlas limpio."
        }, 3800);
      });

      btnSort.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const order = ["recent", "alpha", "rarity"];
        state.sortMode = order[(order.indexOf(state.sortMode) + 1) % order.length];
        saveState();
        applyButtonsState();
        renderInventory();
      });

      btnClear.addEventListener("click", clearBoard);
      btnHint.addEventListener("click", showSmartHint);
      btnAtlas.addEventListener("click", openAtlas);
      btnCloseAtlas.addEventListener("click", closeAtlas);

      atlasModal.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target === atlasModal) closeAtlas();
      });

      btnShare.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const curatedFound = state.discovered.filter((id) => Boolean(ELEMENTS[id])).length;
        const legendaries = state.discovered.filter((id) => ELEMENTS[id] && ELEMENTS[id].rarity === "legendary");
        const pct = Math.round((curatedFound / CURATED_IDS.length) * 100);
        const barFilled = Math.round(pct / 10);
        const bar = "🟥".repeat(barFilled) + "⬜".repeat(10 - barFilled);
        const legIcons = legendaries.map((id) => ELEMENTS[id].emoji).join(" ") || "Ninguno aún";
        const text = `🧪 Alquimia Reactiva (Web Reactiva)\n${bar} ${curatedFound}/${CURATED_IDS.length} (${pct}%)\n★ Legendarios: ${legIcons}\n⚡ Mezclas: ${state.combines} · En pantuflas 🥿`;

        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          btnShare.textContent = "✅ ¡Copiado!";
          setTimeout(() => { btnShare.textContent = "📋 Compartir"; }, 2000);
        } catch {
          prompt("Copia tu progreso malandriner:", text);
        }
      });

      btnReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (!confirm("¿Reiniciar todo tu progreso de Alquimia Reactiva y volver a los 4 elementos iniciales?")) return;
        const keepTheme = state.theme;
        const keepSound = state.sound;
        state = defaultState();
        state.theme = keepTheme;
        state.sound = keepSound;
        saveState();
        clearBoard();
        renderProgress();
        renderInventory();
        renderAtlas();
        closeAtlas();
      });

      searchInput.addEventListener("input", renderInventory);

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
          e.preventDefault();
          searchInput.focus();
          searchInput.select();
        } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
          closeAtlas();
        } else if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "c" && document.activeElement !== searchInput && !atlasModal.classList.contains("open")) {
          clearBoard();
        }
      });

      window.addEventListener("resize", resizeFx);

      /* =====================================================================
       * 12. ARRANQUE INICIAL
       * ===================================================================== */
      applyTheme();
      applyButtonsState();
      resizeFx();
      renderProgress();
      renderInventory();
      updateEmptyGuide();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

- **144 elementos curados y 360 recetas únicas** (verificadas para que el 100% sean alcanzables desde los 4 iniciales) repartidos en 7 categorías:
  - **Comunidad y lore**: Dani Primo, Malandriner, Zona Malandriner, En Pantuflas, Newsletter, 12 Recursos, Asombrósico, Para Fardar, Café del Lunes, Envío 400, YesYak, Wikipoke, Peluca de Dani, Contra las Cuerdas, Código Calambrazo, Esperando a Eskainet…
  - **IA y modelos**: LLM, Token, Ventana de Contexto, Context Rot, Tokenmaxxing, Prefix Cache, Alucinación, AI Slop, Adulación, RAG, Embeddings, Pesos Abiertos, Ollama, Stack Chino (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM)…
  - **Agentes, skills y métodos**: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, MCP, Subagentes, Orquestador, Harness Engineer, Loop/Graph Engineering, Modo AFK, Humano en el Bucle, Dirigible (400€), AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, Cook-First Skills, `grill-me`, `eli5`, `handoff-torch`, `git-commit-organizer`, `caveman`, `taste-skill`, `ponytail`, SDD, OpenSpec, OKF…
  - **Herramientas de webreactiva.com**: Atlas Malandriner, Selector de Modelos, Revisor AGENTS.md, Constructor de Specs, Contador de Tokens, Bingo de Mentiras, Radar de Capas, Chuleta OpenCode, Suscripción vs API, Robotito.
  - **Código, carrera y caos dev**: Git, TDD, Mutation Testing, Testing E2E, Laravel, React, Astro, Docker, Coolify, Despliegue en Viernes, Modo Fuego, Modo Pantano, Vibe Coding, Pánico en la Silla, Deuda Cognitiva, LinkedIn-5-5, Fichómetro, Criterio Humano y Software Factory.
- **Mecánicas y extras**:
  - Arrastrar y soltar en lienzo infinito, clic para añadir, doble clic para duplicar y clic derecho o arrastrar al panel lateral para retirar.
  - **🧭 Atlas Malandriner**: enciclopedia con progreso por categoría, rarezas (incluyendo 8 legendarios), receta descubierta, descripción y botón para compartir progreso.
  - **💡 Sistema de pistas inteligente**: analiza lo que ya tienes desbloqueado y te sugiere una combinación posible en dos niveles.
  - **∞ Modo Libre**: interruptor opcional para que cualquier par sin receta oficial genere fusiones experimentales al estilo *Infinite Craft* sin ensuciar el contador del Atlas.
  - Efectos de partículas en canvas, sonidos sintetizados con Web Audio API (silenciables), tema claro/oscuro, buscador (`Ctrl+K`) y guardado automático en `localStorage`.
